metadata.description: District-level construction and geotechnical profiles for West Bengal
metadata.disclaimer: District profiles are modeled/synthesized from regional soil maps. NOT site-specific recommendations - perform boreholes, lab tests (IS:2720), and local structural design checks before final design.

regulatory.building_plan_portal: Online Building Plan Approval System (OBPAS) - West Bengal
regulatory.planning_act: The West Bengal Town & Country (Planning & Development) Act, 1979

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial - silty loam / sandy loam (Terai foothills)
properties.recommended_foundation: Shallow spread footings for low-rise; piles where saturated strata or high load
properties.drainage_requirement: Surface runoff control; avoid perched water near slopes
properties.special_constraints: Near-forest & riverine zones — local erosion & drainage controls required
properties.notes: Perform slope stability checks for hillside approaches; follow local land-use plan.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings, raft for larger buildings; shallow piles only if weak residual pockets
properties.drainage_requirement: Surface drainage and erosion control (monsoon run-off)
properties.special_constraints: Lateritic crusts can be thin — verify depth to weathered rock
properties.notes: Use compaction & moisture conditioning; check expansive pockets.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial to residual (mix of loam and red soils)
properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings, raft for clustered buildings
properties.drainage_requirement: Manage surface runoff; protect foundations from seasonal saturation
properties.special_constraints: Local low-lying patches and depressions
properties.notes: Standard geotechnical investigation adequate for mid-rise designs.

properties.recommended_foundation: Raft for heavier loads; piles where organic/fill layers present
properties.drainage_requirement: High — flood-proofing and raised plinths recommended
properties.special_constraints: Flood & seasonal inundation; high water table
properties.notes: Design for scour, settlement monitoring for long-term works.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings; piles locally where compressible soil found
properties.drainage_requirement: Surface runoff control and lateral drainage
properties.special_constraints: Agricultural reclaimed lands in places
properties.notes: Check for shallow compressible layers before design.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings on competent benches; piles/anchored foundations on steep slopes
properties.drainage_requirement: Critical — slope drainage, retaining walls and terraces
properties.special_constraints: Landslide / slope stability risk; strict drainage & retaining design required
properties.notes: Require thorough slope stability and LID (landslide inventory) checks prior to construction.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial clayey / silty soils near river corridors
properties.recommended_foundation: Raft or piles for large structures; spread for small buildings with ground improvement
properties.drainage_requirement: Subsurface drainage near riverbanks; flood-resilient plinths
properties.special_constraints: Riverbank erosion in stretches; saline pockets near estuaries
properties.notes: Coordinate with river-protection authorities for river-adjacent works.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial estuarine and reclaimed areas (clayey / silty)
properties.recommended_foundation: Pile foundations commonly recommended for medium-to-heavy loads
properties.drainage_requirement: Subsurface drainage and dewatering for deep excavations
properties.special_constraints: High water table & reclaimed fill pockets
properties.notes: Corrosion-resistant design recommended in saline proximities.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial plain with silty-sandy soils; river terraces
properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings; piles in river-adjacent soft areas
properties.drainage_requirement: Manage monsoon runoff; prevent riverbank scour
properties.special_constraints: Flood-prone localities; check for organic layers in old wetlands
properties.notes: Combine geotech inputs with river hydrology for waterfront projects.

properties.typical_soil: Hill / colluvial soils with rock outcrops
properties.recommended_foundation: Shallow pads on rock benches; piles or anchors on escarpments
properties.drainage_requirement: Extensive slope drainage and retaining structures
properties.special_constraints: Landslide-susceptible; stringent slope engineering required
properties.notes: Local rock/soil mapping and bench-by-bench design necessary.

properties.typical_soil: Clayey (soft to medium stiff estuarine clays) — high water table
properties.recommended_foundation: Raft or pile foundations (deep piles for tall structures)
properties.drainage_requirement: Subsurface drainage and waterproofing mandatory
properties.special_constraints: High settlement risk, corrosion and seasonal variation; municipal rules strict
properties.notes: Refer to local geotechnical logs and Kolkata Municipal Corporation building rules; well-documented urban master plans exist for New Town / WBHIDCO areas.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings; raft for low-to-mid rise; piles in organic fills
properties.drainage_requirement: Flood-proofing on low-lying floodplains
properties.special_constraints: Riverine flooding and seasonal saturation; check historical flood maps
properties.notes: Use SLUSI / state soil maps for localized planning.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial fine silts & clays (Ganges distributary plains)
properties.recommended_foundation: Raft/pile combinations for heavy structures; ground improvement recommended
properties.drainage_requirement: High; flood and bank-protection measures
properties.special_constraints: Riverbank erosion and historical flooding influence design
properties.notes: Prioritize drainage corridors and long-term settlement monitoring.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings; piles where compressible or reclaimed land found
properties.drainage_requirement: Subsurface drainage where high water table exists
properties.special_constraints: Flood plains and levee-proximity zones
properties.notes: Coordinate with river management authorities for riverside works.

properties.recommended_foundation: Deep piles for urban/reclaimed areas; raft for stable pockets
properties.drainage_requirement: Subsurface drainage; coastal flood management where relevant
properties.special_constraints: Rapid urbanization, reclaimed lands, and tidal influence
properties.notes: OBPAS approvals required for urban localities; coordinate with development authority plans.

properties.recommended_foundation: Deep pile foundations; platforming & ground improvement required
properties.drainage_requirement: Advanced dewatering, tidal management and coastal defenses
properties.special_constraints: Wetlands, mangroves, high corrosion & environmental sensitivity
properties.notes: Strict environmental clearances & long-term settlement/corrosion mitigation needed; see SLUSI coastal maps.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial & industrial backfills (urbanized Asansol/ Durgapur belt)
properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings where clean native soil; piles where fill/contamination present
properties.drainage_requirement: Control of industrial runoff; consider contamination checks
properties.special_constraints: Post-industrial land, presence of fill — geotechnical & contamination testing recommended
properties.notes: Coordinate with local industrial development authorities for remediation and reuse.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings or raft for clusters; piles for heavy infrastructure
properties.drainage_requirement: Monsoon runoff management; levee adjacent structures need scour checks
properties.special_constraints: Agricultural reclaimed pockets
properties.notes: Use district soil maps for zoning of heavy infrastructure.

properties.recommended_foundation: Piles for coastal/high water-table zones; shallow footings inland
properties.drainage_requirement: Coastal protection and dewatering systems
properties.special_constraints: Salt attack potential on concrete & steel; coastal regulations
properties.notes: Salt-resistant materials and protective coatings recommended.

properties.typical_soil: Alluvial plains, red lateritic pockets inland
properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings generally viable; piles where soft alluvium present
properties.drainage_requirement: Surface runoff and riverbank protection in parts
properties.special_constraints: Variable sub-surface materials; check for lateritic benches
properties.notes: Site-by-site geotech essential for major structures.

properties.recommended_foundation: Shallow spread footings commonly suitable; rock anchors where needed
properties.drainage_requirement: Erosion control and monsoon drainage
properties.special_constraints: Scarcity of groundwater in parts; check for expansive pockets
properties.notes: Good bearing capacity on rock; variable over weathered profiles.

properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings for low-rise; piles for heavy loads or soft pockets
properties.drainage_requirement: Monsoon drainage and flood-mapping checks
properties.special_constraints: Flood-prone strips near river channels
properties.notes: Local hydrology mapping recommended for site placement.

properties.typical_soil: Red lateritic soils with alluvial patches
properties.recommended_foundation: Spread footings; raft for soft spots
properties.drainage_requirement: Surface runoff control; slope protection in undulating areas
properties.special_constraints: Erosion & gullies in undulating terrain
properties.notes: Local test pits often adequate for small structures.
